BossRecord.title: BossRecord
BossRecord.description: Represents a boss spawn timer tracking entry for a specific server

id.description: Unique identifier composed of serverId and bossKey

bossKey.description: Unique key identifier of the boss type

serverId.description: Identifier for the game server, e.g. server_1 or server_2

serverTag.description: Short tag of the server like [T3]

cooldownHours.description: Normal respawn cooldown duration in hours

rebootHours.description: Respawn cooldown duration after server maintenance/reboot in hours

lastKilledAt.description: ISO timestamp when the boss was last killed or recorded

nextSpawnAt.description: ISO timestamp when the boss is predicted to respawn

updatedBy.description: Name or identifier of the user who performed the last update

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the updater

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the record update

isCustom.description: Flag indicating if the boss was created manually by users

isFavorite.description: Flag indicating if the boss is marked favorite

ServerConfig.title: ServerConfig
ServerConfig.description: Global or per-server configuration including Discord webhook settings and reboot timestamp

lastRebootAt.description: ISO timestamp when the server was rebooted

/bosses/{bossId}.description: Collection of boss timers across servers

/server_configs/{configId}.description: Configuration records for server settings and discord integrations
